headline: Manxhuka: Kosovo has not bought electricity from Serbia, but companies were not prohibited from doing so
summary: Kosovo's government decided to ban the trade of electricity with Serbian companies. A Vetëvendosje spokesperson said such trade had not previously been prohibited for companies.
why: Electricity trade between neighbouring Balkan systems affects supply security and power prices in both countries and the regional grid.
